description: Step 1 of adding a picture that is a file on your computer (PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 10 MB). Returns a one-time upload address: PUT the file's bytes there with its Content-Type, then call finish_project_picture with upload_id. rendering true = one of the project's final renderings (shown first, large); item_id = that item's picture; neither = a project file. Owner only. Needs the owner's sign-in.

caption.description: The picture's title, e.g. "Lobby · front desk"

item_id.description: Item id, for an item's picture

rendering.description: true for a final rendering of the project

name: start_project_picture
title: Upload a picture file
